title: 5GS session management via a satellite NG-RAN cell

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The user equipment that applies NAS timer values for satellite NG-RAN cell access.

entities.name: Access and Mobility Management Function
entities.description: The AMF indicates whether extended NAS timers should be used for satellite NG-RAN cell access.

entities.name: Session Management Function
entities.description: The SMF calculates NAS timer values when extended timer usage is indicated for satellite NG-RAN cell access.

entities.name: NAS Timer for Satellite NG-RAN Cell
entities.description: NAS timer with extended values applicable when accessing via a satellite NG-RAN cell.

entities.name: Extended NAS Timer Indication
entities.description: Condition where AMF indicates that extended NAS timers should be used for satellite NG-RAN cell access.

entities.name: NAS Procedure
entities.description: Generic NAS procedure during which NAS timer values are calculated at start and remain fixed until completion, restart, or abortion.

relations.description: UE applies the NAS timer value for satellite NG-RAN cell access at the start of a NAS procedure.
AMF indicates the use of extended NAS timers for satellite NG-RAN cell access.
When extended timer indication is present, SMF calculates the NAS timer value for satellite access.
SMF calculates and applies the NAS timer value for satellite NG-RAN cell access when indicated.
NAS timer value is calculated at the start of a NAS procedure and remains fixed until procedure completion, restart, or abortion.
